transcript.text: lg w/d keeps saying dE n wont start?? door is shut

The 'dE' code typically relates to the door being locked or a fault with the door lock mechanism. LG machines frequently keep the door locked for 1-2 minutes after a programme ends to allow the drum to cool down. Additionally, if the child lock was accidentally activated, it will prevent the door from opening. Please switch the machine off at the wall socket, wait about 5 minutes, and then try opening the door again. Does it open now?
its not that, the door is shut, it just wont start. i can try turning it off n on tho

That is a good idea; a full power reset often clears temporary glitches in the control board that keep the machine locked even when it should be ready to start. Please switch the machine off at the wall socket, wait about 2 minutes, and then turn it back on. Let me know if the 'dE' code disappears or changes, and whether the door unlocks after this.
ok did the off n on, still says dE with the duvet in it

Since you have a duvet inside, this is very likely an unbalanced load issue rather than a fault with the door lock itself. Washing machines will refuse to start or spin if they detect that a heavy item like a duvet has clumped to one side of the drum, as this can cause dangerous vibration. Please switch the machine off and unplug it for safety. Open the door (if it opens now), take out the duvet if possible, or at least spread it evenly around the drum so it isn't bunched up. Close the door firmly and try starting a programme again. If the door is still locked tight after 5 minutes with no power, that would point to a genuine lock fault.
the door does shut tho, it just springs back a bit when i close it. the duvet is bulging against the glass n a corner is squashed in the rubber seal. want me to take it out?

Yes, please take the duvet out. A heavy item like that often clumps to one side and stops the machine from starting or spinning for safety reasons. Once it's removed, close the door firmly until you hear a click and try starting a normal wash programme again.
[Helpful to see: image "About the door lock (interlock)" — The door lock (interlock) keeps the door shut during a wash and stops the machine starting unless the door is locked. This reference shows where it sits. If the door won't open, wait 2–3 minutes after the cycle ends for the lock to release before trying again. A faulty interlock is a replacement part best fitted by a qualified engineer.]
ok took it out. shut the door n it clicks properly now, want me to start a normal wash?

Yes, please go ahead and start a normal wash. The 'dE' code was triggered because the heavy duvet clumped to one side, which the machine interpreted as an unsafe load. To prevent this from happening again with bulky items like duvets or pillows, try spreading them out evenly in the drum before starting, or add a couple of smaller towels to help balance the weight.
